name: Robledillo de Trujillo (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and green, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Robledillo de Trujillo (a castle and an oak on green and white).
history: Municipal flag of Robledillo de Trujillo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Robledillo de Trujillo arms — castle and oak
